summary: bol is webshop in the Netherlands. Type: private company. About 4,998 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 1 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Utrecht-based largest online retailer in the Netherlands and Belgium, with about 5,000 staff; has a senior compliance role that shows pay, but no IND sponsor status.

culture.text: A big Dutch employer of about 4,998 people, headquartered in Utrecht, started in 1999 as the first Dutch online bookstore.
Staff often come from Hogeschool Utrecht, University of Amsterdam, VU Amsterdam, Utrecht University and Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences.
Main jobs are in engineering, operations, business development, IT and marketing.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so visa sponsorship is unlikely.
Its one open job here, a senior risk and compliance role in Utrecht, does not require Dutch and shows the salary.

growth.text: Has started building a new distribution centre in Lelystad, while another warehouse plan is on hold.
Grew from a Dutch bookstore into a marketplace for other retailers, expanding to Belgium in 2010 and opening its own fulfilment centre in 2017.

worth_knowing.text: The Utrecht compliance role drew about 162 applicants on LinkedIn on average.
